# PROtect

> PROtect delivers comprehensive safety, reliability, and compliance solutions for industrial operations through expert consulting, API-certified inspections, and enterprise software.

PROtect specializes in mechanical integrity, process safety management, environmental compliance, and asset integrity across industries including oil & gas, biofuels, construction, and data centers. The company combines field services (NDT, rope access, emissions monitoring) with enterprise software (SHIELD platform) to help organizations meet regulatory requirements and operational excellence standards.

## Key Topics

- Mechanical Integrity (MI)
- Process Safety Management (PSM)
- API Certifications (510/570/580/653)
- Leak Detection and Repair (LDAR)
- Non-Destructive Testing (NDT)
- Asset Integrity Management
- OSHA Compliance
- Environmental Compliance
- Risk Management
- SHIELD Software Platform
- Pipeline Integrity
- Industrial Safety
- Emissions Monitoring
- Regulatory Compliance
- EHS Consulting

## Core Services

- [Expert Safety, Reliability, & Compliance Services](https://protect.llc/services): Main services overview page for PROtect's safety and compliance offerings.
- [Mechanical Integrity & API Inspections](https://protect.llc/service/mechanical-integrity): Mechanical integrity programs and API 510/570/580/653 certified inspections.
- [Non-Destructive Testing (NDT)](https://protect.llc/service/non-destructive-testing): API-certified NDT inspections using ultrasonic and radiography technologies.
- [Pipeline Integrity Services](https://protect.llc/service/pipeline-integrity): Pipeline NDT services with corrosion mapping and defect sizing capabilities.
- [Process Safety Management & Engineering](https://protect.llc/service/engineering): Process safety management and engineering consulting services by PROtect.
- [Safety & Industrial Hygiene Programs](https://protect.llc/service/safety): OSHA-compliant safety programs and industrial hygiene consulting services.
- [Emissions Monitoring & Mitigation](https://protect.llc/service/emissions-monitoring-and-mitigation): Emissions monitoring and regulatory compliance service for fugitive emissions.

## Specialized Technical Services

- [Environmental & Regulatory Compliance Support](https://protect.llc/service/environmental): Environmental compliance audits and regulatory support with LeakDAS and GuideWare.
- [Flexible Digital Radiography (FLEX DR)](https://protect.llc/service/flexible-digital-radiography): FLEX DR digital radiography service for rapid, safe inspection projects.
- [Heat Treatment & Stress Relief](https://protect.llc/service/heat-treatment-and-stress-relief): Post-weld heat treatment and stress relief services for material integrity.
- [Rope Access Services](https://protect.llc/service/rope-access): Rope access services for mechanical integrity and LDAR monitoring tasks.
- [Insurance Risk Control & Management](https://protect.llc/service/insurance-risk-control-and-management): Risk assessment and insurance management consulting for workplace safety.

## Software & Training Solutions

- [SHIELD Asset Integrity Management Software](https://protect.llc/shield-software): SHIELD asset integrity management software with IDMS, RBI, and CHEMTRACK.
- [Compliance Software Solutions](https://protect.llc/service/software): Enterprise risk management and compliance software solutions for industries.
- [Training & Learning Management System](https://protect.llc/service/training): Online LMS offering OSHA, HAZWOPER, and industrial safety training courses.

## Industry Solutions

- [Biofuels Production Facilities](https://protect.llc/industry/biofuels): Risk management and compliance solutions for biofuels production facilities.
- [Construction Projects](https://protect.llc/industry/construction): Construction safety and compliance assurance services by PROtect.
- [Data Centers](https://protect.llc/industry/data-centers): Data center compliance and infrastructure inspection services for uptime.
